question: How can I reset my password?
answer: You can reset it through the account settings.

question: I forgot my password.
answer: Click forgot password on the login page and check your email.

question: My account is locked.
answer: Wait fifteen minutes or contact support to unlock it.

question: Where is my order?
answer: You can track your order in the orders section.

question: My order is delayed.
answer: We are sorry for the delay. Your order will arrive soon.

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: Yes. You can cancel it before it is shipped.

question: I received a damaged item.
answer: Please send us a photo and we will replace the item.

question: I got the wrong item.
answer: We are sorry. We will send the right item for free.

question: How do I get a refund?
answer: Open the order and press request refund.

question: When will I get my money back?
answer: The refund takes five to seven days.

question: How can I return an item?
answer: You can return it within thirty days in the orders section.

question: My card was declined.
answer: Please check the card details or try another card.

question: I was charged twice.
answer: We will check the payment and refund the extra charge.

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept cards and bank transfer.

question: How do I change my email?
answer: You can update it in your profile settings.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Open the profile settings and press delete account.

question: How can I change my address?
answer: You can update the address in your profile settings.

question: How much does delivery cost?
answer: Delivery is free for orders over fifty dollars.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Delivery takes two to four days.

question: Do you ship abroad?
answer: Yes. We ship to most countries.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer: Open the subscription page and press cancel.

question: Can I pause my subscription?
answer: Yes. You can pause it for up to three months.

question: My discount code does not work.
answer: Please check the expiry date of the code.

question: Do you have any discounts?
answer: You can find current offers on the sales page.

question: I want to talk to a human.
answer: An agent will join the chat in a few minutes.

question: What are your working hours?
answer: Our support works every day from nine to nine.

question: The app does not open.
answer: Please update the app and restart your phone.

question: The app is very slow.
answer: Please clear the cache and update the app.

question: Is there a warranty?
answer: Every item has a warranty of one year.

question: My item stopped working.
answer: Please contact support and we will repair the item under warranty.
